run_group_duplicate_urls: run the script to group duplicate URLs from a JSONL input file by Jaccard similarity
run_is_similar_check: run the is_similar function to check if a Jaccard similarity score meets the 0.9 threshold
group_urls_by_similarity: group URLs from a JSONL file into clusters based on Jaccard similarity scores above 0.9
merge_duplicate_url_groups: merge URL groups that share common URLs using a union-find-like approach across JSONL lines
output_duplicate_url_clusters: output clusters of duplicate URLs as JSON lines to a specified output file
